jobs.title: Public Safety Officer (Guard) 3rd Shift, University Police
jobs.company: The University of Texas at San Antonio
jobs.description:
Position Information

Title: Public Safety Officer

Salary Range: $36,894 annualized, commensurate with education, experience, and qualifications.

Job Type: Full Time

Shift: 3rd shift (10:00 pm – 6:00 am)

Posting Close Date: Applications will be accepted through 11:59 PM CDT on 07/15/2026. At the discretion of the hiring department, this posting may close once a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received.

Job Summary

The Public Safety Officer is responsible for providing security to protect the safety and welfare of students, employees, visitors, and property within the control and jurisdiction of The University of Texas at San Antonio. This role serves as a Campus Security Authority as defined by the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Campus Crime Statistics Act (Clery Act) and enforces the University of Texas System Administration rules and regulations regarding safeguarding students, employees, visitors, property, and buildings.

Core Responsibilities

  • Enforce the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of the University of Texas System and the University.
  • Conduct regular patrols (on foot, golf cart, motor vehicle, including a truck, and by bicycle if certified) of both the main and downtown campuses.
  • Perform guard tours of controlled spaces, patrol buildings, parking lots, and other UTSA‑controlled property to assist with asset protection, provide security presence, and prevent crime.
  • Inspect buildings and grounds to check for fires, water leaks, and potential security and safety hazards. Investigate and report abnormalities.
  • Assist with security surveys to identify safety and security deficiencies such as lighting, landscaping, and safety concerns.
  • Inspect emergency phones and other security equipment.
  • Assist with emergency response and provide emergency assistance when needed.
  • Provide security support for special events (e.g., weddings, sporting events, concerts) by opening and closing facilities, conducting security sweeps, assigning fixed posts, bag checks, and security camera surveillance.
  • Provide customer service to the public by offering security escorts, motorist assistance, information and direction to students, employees, and visitors; direct traffic.
  • Utilize a handheld radio for communication with dispatch, supervisors, other Public Safety officers, and Police.
  • Write electronic reports and take observational field notes.
  • Unlock and secure buildings and classrooms in both public and non‑public areas; report issues regarding the function and maintenance of entries and exits, including doors, door locks, and other security systems.
  • Respond to calls for service, alarms, and/or observed behaviors. Provide requested services promptly and in accordance with policies and procedures.
  • Examine credentials of persons desiring to enter controlled areas.
  • Attend meetings and training.
  • Assist security service and police teams.
  • Perform other duties as assigned, including emergency recall and/or remaining on‑site or working as required.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, Vocational Training, or Apprenticeship in a related field.
  • One (1) year of demonstrated ability to uphold responsibilities, reliably meet commitments and expectations, and exhibit dependability and accountability through employment, volunteer work, or community involvement.
  • Ability to maintain the security and integrity of UT San Antonio and its infrastructure per Texas EO‑GA‑48.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Communication
  • Microsoft Office Suite proficiency
  • Familiarity and experience with Police Department equipment
  • Sharp Acumen

Working Conditions

  • Work involves a high degree of hazard normally associated with law enforcement.
  • May be required to work day, evening, night, and power shifts with varying days off.
  • Exposure to outside weather conditions; must be flexible to work evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Requires walking and standing without the aid of canes, crutches, or similar tools.
  • Assignments may vary between the Main campus and Downtown campus to provide 24/7 coverage.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to walk, climb stairs, stand, and sit, both inside and outside, for extended periods of time.

Location and Contingencies

This position will be located on the main and/or downtown campus. Must be flexible to work at either campus as needed. Travel and parking expenses are the employee’s responsibility. This position is contingent upon a successful background check, verification of a valid driver’s license and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) where applicable, and proof of eligibility to work in the United States by time of hire.

Equal Employment Opportunity

As an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer, it is the policy of The University of Texas at San Antonio to promote and ensure equal employment opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or genetic information, and veteran status. The University is committed to the affirmative action program in compliance with all government requirements to ensure non‑discrimination.

UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more.

With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has also been recognized as a Top Employer in Texas by Forbes Magazine. Learn more online, on UT San Antonio Today or on X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or LinkedIn.

Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Personnel Screening in New Braunfels, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Tech/Media/Telecom, and more. As a Screener supporting a dynamic technology, media, and telecommunications location, you will help create a welcoming, controlled environment by screening visitors, monitoring access points, and communicating professionally with employees and guests. Your visible presence and attention to detail will help deter security-related incidents while delivering exceptional customer service. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable, and innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity put people first.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $17.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon05:30 AM - 05:30 PMTue05:30 AM - 05:30 PMWed05:30 AM - 05:30 PM

  • Monitor entry points, visitor activity, and prohibited-item screening processes; report unusual activity or policy violations to appropriate personnel.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following site emergency response procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of assigned screening areas, access points, and the surrounding business perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity.

Minimum Requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.

  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law.
